metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-161. - Measurement of distances.
content.summary:
All distances under this article shall be measured from the tangent points of any
               curb radii or the ends of any flares.
(Code 1981, § 30-146; Ord. No. 1544, § 4(A), 3-19-1979)
